scope: Prepared motion inventory, provenance and review routing. Availability is not approval of a rendered performance.

inventory_checks: Declared frame counts match q, rot, root and contact array shapes.
All stored motion arrays contain finite values.
All stored foot contact confidence values lie in [0, 1].

motion.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
motion.acknowledgement: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
motion.raw_source_audit_limit: Original BVH files were not reacquired or fingerprinted during this inventory audit. Capture identities come from the committed import recipe and asset README.

provenance.code_only_meaning: The engine draws the pictures from geometry and motion data. This does not mean the underlying body geometry or captured choreography was invented entirely by project code.

stored_format.local_rotation_array: mclip_<id>_q: [frame, 25 driven bones, quaternion wxyz], float16
stored_format.root_translation_array: mclip_<id>_root: [frame, xyz], float32; metres at stored reference leg length, scaled by runtime body leg length
stored_format.contact_array: mclip_<id>_contact: [frame, left/right confidence], float32; heuristic, not measured force or a reviewed event annotation

timing.cycle_period: N / fps, including interpolation from the last sample back to the first with root travel.
timing.one_shot_span: (N - 1) / fps; single clips hold their endpoint outside the sample span.
timing.native_output_fps: Independent of prepared motion rate. Rendering at 60 fps interpolates the stored 30 Hz poses.
timing.original_capture_rate: Not retained as a per-clip field in this bundle. The official CMU subject 5 catalog, cited in NATURAL-PERFORMANCE-RESEARCH.md, separately lists 05_02 at 120 Hz.

other_motion_sources.note: Procedural states, hand shapes and gestures are authored code, not extra captured clips. Aliases also add no new capture.

common_limits: Twenty-five driven bones and float16 local rotations are a prepared retargeted representation, not original optical capture.
Finger and thumb performance is not captured; current hand shapes and gestures are procedural or authored.
Foot confidence is inferred from low/slow foot trajectories and is not proof of stable support, force balance or exact floor contact.
Retargeting, body proportions, arm clearance, root placement, garment motion and camera staging can change the visible result.
Source motion, body geometry, retargeting, procedural additions and final encoded movie need separate provenance and review records.

acquisition_policy: No candidate dataset was downloaded for this inventory. A future addition needs source terms and hashes, a versioned import recipe, retargeting, reviewed contacts, a plain-floor motion proof, a costume proof and a registered scene before it is advertised as ready.

authored_scores.scope: Reusable authored scores and integrations, with limited native QA. Existing prepared clips and historical statuses remain unchanged.

reference_inputs.use: Decoded moving reference for solo fan sweeps and levels; not pose or contact reconstruction.
Decoded moving reference for the ensemble fan canon; not independently captured performers.
Globe-to-people visual reference for film 3; not a dancer choreography input.

dance_runtime.coordinates: Metres; +Y up; body-frame targets scaled from a 1.65 m reference height.
dance_runtime.clock: clip((t - delay) * 20 / (20 - delay), 0, 20); delays are seconds, with the score compressed to settle at scene time 20.
dance_runtime.install_requirement: Install before Body.where/joint/sample, Calligraphy track construction or cloth sampling. Use the scene body setup; external gesture/hand overrides and changed placement need new review.
dance_runtime.contact_measurement_source: Dancer implementation agent report on 2026-11-22; rounded measurements transcribed here, not rerun during documentation.

shared_limits: The new solo and ensemble scores are original authored choreography guided by the supplied recordings, not motion capture or reconstructed source performance. Calligraphy and flight scores are independently authored.
The earlier automatic pose estimates for feet hidden by skirts were not verified in this round and were not used as measured support contacts.
The 81-sample dance reports cover 0 to 20 seconds at 0.25-second intervals. They do not establish every shutter subframe, every ensemble role, costume collision freedom or force-driven balance.
Prepared walking retains the existing CMU capture provenance and does not add to the eight prepared clips or seven distinct captures.
Working QA artifacts are under ignored work/ directories. This catalog records their scoped findings, not a durable-media upload or final movie approval.
Whole-film completion, encoded final QA and exact-output owner approval belong to the versioned delivery catalog and STATE.json.

entries.action: Rising spiral, lateral opening and resolved offering with two solved palms, torso levels, heading changes and 24 explicit alternating steps.
entries.provenance: DanceScore inherits the existing TrioPerformance support/diagnostic API and Step representation; its score curves and step targets are original authored code, not a new captured clip.

review.finding: Late near fan lowered to preserve the head silhouette; final frontal full body remains framed. Attachment inspected visually.

limits: The current solo adds finite silk; the inherited simulation has body-capsule collision but no cloth self-collision or other-body collision.
No independent numerical fan-to-palm attachment residual was recorded.

entries.action: Five performers use role-dependent travel and heading, paired petal poses and a delayed canon; all scores resolve at scene time 20 seconds.
entries.provenance: An original variation family on the shared authored support solver; roles are not five independent motion captures.

review.finding: Five complete bodies and ten held fans are readable in the reviewed native frame. Numeric contact sampling covered role 2 only.

limits: Other roles and delays do not inherit the role-2 numerical result as a full contact certification.
This scene uses pleated fan surfaces and petal wakes; it does not add the solo finite-silk sheets to all ten fans.

entries.action: The right palm writes three spatial flourishes while the left balances; the written strokes expand, retreat in depth and rise after the hand passes.
entries.provenance: Independently authored for the calligraphy brief. No supplied recording demonstrated this wrist score, and no source handwriting or glyph was reconstructed.

sampling.tip_binding: The live stroke endpoint is corrected to body.where(t, "palm.R") after smoothing.

review.finding: Substantial brush strokes originate at the wrist; full-body and foot margins remain clear in the reviewed frames.

limits: The strokes are abstract flourishes, not linguistically accurate lettering.
Smoothing changes historical stroke geometry; the final endpoint is attached to the current solved palm.

provenance.dataset: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
provenance.authored_additions: Placement, speed/phase, stops, facing, gesture timing and solved-palm lantern attachment. No new walk capture or source-video gait reconstruction.

review.finding: Root and nature-agent review of films 5/10 found no blocking clipping, missing bodies or detached lanterns in these frames. Lantern cord reaches the solved palm; reunion lead turns from the arrival toward the front through the authored shuffle.

film3_cut_proof.finding: No camera-shutter ghosting at frame 540; authored gold wipe clears by approximately 9.42 seconds.

limits: Gait uses the existing Body/Actor travel/contact system; no new numerical planted-foot, stride-matching or physical-balance test was recorded for films 3, 5 or 10.
The lantern is attached by an authored offset and cord, not a simulated grasp or pendulum.

entries.provenance: Subclasses tools.concert_addons.models.Dove. Reuses its fixed-length shoulder/elbow/wrist wing articulation and feather helpers; this round authors the continuous flight path/state, torso-neck-head loft, beak/tail arrangement, formation and glide timing.
entries.action: One hero and seven followers fly continuously; tangent-based heading, banking, articulated flapping and two eased glide phases operate at absolute scene time.

continuous_proof.identity_limit: Proof predates the butterfly-only correction in the shared module. Bird geometry is unchanged; it is not the final whole-film source-identity proof.

limits: Always airborne during seconds 0 to 20. Inherited launch/landing foot locks are not exercised or verified by this film.
No independent numerical joint-length, aerodynamic or biomechanical test was recorded.
WingWake follows root history at 110 times over 2.6 seconds with world-X offsets of +/-0.85 m; it is an artistic trail, not measured wingtip motion.

entries.provenance: Original code-authored four-membrane wing geometry, thorax, antennae, flutter and formation. No motion capture, inverse reference fitting or biological flight simulation.
entries.action: A traveling leader and delayed followers open into a formation; paired fore/hind wing membranes flutter at authored base frequency 3.1 Hz.

prior_composition_evidence.limit: Predates the correction that turns all butterfly parts toward flight; do not treat as corrected-source proof.

limits: The numerical forward check covered the leader only; followers include additional authored offsets.
The path and reveal are specific to the twenty-second garden scene; arbitrary destinations, durations and looping are not validated.

final_movie_evidence.scope: Final encoded movie evidence for all ten registered scenes. Existing authored-score inventory, dated entry reviews, provenance and numerical limits are preserved unchanged. An empty score-entry list means no separate reusable score entry was inventoried for that scene.
